summary: Working in religious studies and Indology, Samani Pratibha Pragya earned her PhD from SOAS University of London and was attested there as a research assistant in 2020.

Samdhong Rinpoche is a scholar of Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy who studied at Drepung and Gyuto monasteries under teachers including Ngawang Jinpa and the 14th Dalai Lama. He served as principal and director of the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies (~1977-1988).

Specializing in Tibetology and religious studies, Karmay studied at Drepung Monastery and SOAS under David L. Snellgrove. He held posts at SOAS, CNRS (Directeur de Recherche, 1980), and served as President of the International Association for Tibetan Studies (1996).

Samuel Beal was a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology who earned his B.A. at Trinity College, Cambridge (~1843-1847). He served as Professor of Chinese at University College London from ~1877 to 1889.

Samuel M. Grupper specializes in Iranian and Central Asian studies, sinology, and Buddhist studies. He completed his PhD at Indiana University, where he studied under Irving Yucheng Lo and Philip West.

Sandra A. Wawrytko works in philosophy, sinology, and Buddhist studies. Her career includes posts at San Diego State University, where she was attested as Professor in 1999 and Associate Professor of Philosophy in 2014.
Sandra Bell is a scholar in religious and Buddhist studies who completed her doctoral thesis at Durham University in 1991 and later held an academic post there.
Sandra Hochwarter works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. She earned her Mag.phil. at the University of Vienna, where she studied under MA supervisor Klaus-Dieter Mathes and teacher Anne MacDonald.
Sang-Kyun Sun is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed his PhD at the University of Delhi under Sanghasen Singh and served as a lecturer at JinGak Sangha College (attested 1995).

Sangay Dorji is a scholar in Tibetology, linguistics, and Buddhist studies who studied at Tengtho Monastery and Simtokha Dzong. He served as a teacher at Simtokha Dzong and as Secretary of the Dzongkha Development Commission.
Sangharakshita was a religious and Buddhist studies figure who studied under traditional teacher C. M. Chen (~1950-1964) and founded the Triratna Buddhist Community in 1968.

Sangseraima Ujeed is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. She earned her doctorate at the University of Oxford (~2013-2018) and held a postdoctoral fellowship at the University of California, Santa Barbara (~2018-2020).
Sangye Tenzin was a scholar of Tibetology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. He studied at Drepung Monastery and served as Abbot of Menri Monastery.

Historian Sanjay Subrahmanyam studied at the University of Delhi and Delhi School of Economics. He has held posts at EHESS (~1995-2002), Oxford (~2002-2004), UCLA (~2004), and the Collège de France (~2013-2021).
Sanjit Kumar Sadhukhan is an active scholar in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology who studied under Mrinalkanti Gangopadhyaya and traditional teacher A. P. Lama.

Sanjukta Gupta is an Indology and religious studies scholar educated at Calcutta, Visva-Bharati, and Utrecht under Jan Gonda. She held academic posts at Visva-Bharati (~1959-1967), Jadavpur (~1967-1971), Utrecht (~1971-1986), and Oxford (~1989-2000).
Sanne Dokter-Mersch is an Indologist who completed her PhD at Leiden University (~2016-2021) under the supervision of Peter Bisschop and Yuko Yokochi.

Sao Htun Hmat Win is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Mingun Jetawun Sayadaw and at Harvard. He held posts at the University of Yangon, the International Institute of Advanced Buddhistic Studies, and Myanmar's Ministry of Religious Affairs.

Scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Indology, McClintock studied at Columbia, Lausanne, CIHTS, and earned her PhD at Harvard (-2002) under Tom J. F. Tillemans. She has held posts at UW-Madison (2003) and Emory University.
Sarah Aoife Richardson is a scholar of art history, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology who completed her PhD at the University of Toronto in 2016 under doctoral supervisor Jenny Purtle.
